name: lingonect-app
description: Lingonect mobile apps — Capacitor native wrappers (iOS + Android) of the Lingonect web app.

scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
